content:
Ravi Singh: Heads-up  Medivance (MDV-201) attempted payment for INV-5312 ($13,200) via their virtual card provider and it failed. Portal shows 'card_authorization_declined' but card network says 'exceeds issuer limit'. They asked if we can accept split payment or a one-time ACH.
Izzy Cole: Virtual cards often have per-transaction limits or inline MCC restrictions. Do we have the decline from the VP (vendor)? Any decline code?
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Charge failed for INV-5312. Error: card_authorization_declined. Decline_reason: issuer_decline_limit. Suggested actions: request alternate card, offer split payment (requires manual invoice update), or accept wire/ACH after approvals. Created ticket PAY-8421.
Ravi Singh: Vendor log: ```
{"event":"charge.failed","id":"evt_6LMnX","reason":"issuer_decline_limit","metadata":{"acct":"MDV-201","invoice":"INV-5312"}}
``` Customer says their treasury can issue two cards but they want to avoid multiple transactions. They proposed: pay $7k now and $6,200 tomorrow.
Nora Li: For split payments we need to update invoice schedule and note exposure. Finance can accept staged payment if a signed payment plan email is received and total clears within 72 hours. Also approve wire if they prefer single transfer, but >$10k needs CFO acknowledgement.
Victor Huang: Can we create a temporary split-invoice in billing so the portal accepts two payments? That would make reconciliation easier.
Izzy Cole: Yes, we can issue a pay-split token: create two child payments (P1=7000, P2=6200) and link to INV-5312. Manual work in billing UI, takes ~10-15 minutes. Audit trail will show both payments applied.
Ravi Singh: Customer asked for fastest path. They can wire now but need Redwood's SWIFT for same-day. Otherwise they'll issue two virtual cards which takes ~1 hour. What do we want them to do?
PaymentsBot: NOTE: Wire option requires CFO sign-off for amounts >$10k. Subtask PAY-8421-WIRE created.
Nora Li: I can pre-authorize a wire acceptance for $13,200 pending Marco's (CFO) ack. @Marco please respond if you approve one-off wire acceptance for INV-5312 (will require signed waiver + confirmation of sender fees).
Ravi Singh: Customer is leaning toward split cards to avoid wire fees. Izzy, please prepare split-invoice and one-time pay links for both amounts and mark them to expire in 6 hours.
Izzy Cole: Done. Links generated: https://billing.redwood.ai/one-time-pay?part=P1-INV5312 (7000) and https://billing.redwood.ai/one-time-pay?part=P2-INV5312 (6200). Audit tag: PAY-8421-SPLIT.
Victor Huang: Finance, note that staged payment increases AR risk window. Nora will you accept staged payment terms if customer provides a signed payment plan?
Nora Li: Yes, accept staged payment with signed plan and card authorization receipts attached. No service suspension while plan is on track. If second payment misses, we revert to suspension and apply late fee per T&C. Please attach plan to PAY-8421.
Ravi Singh: Sent both links to customer. They replied: "Issuing two virtual cards now, expect second payment within 24 hours." Attached screenshot of card tokens being created.
PaymentsBot: UPDATE: Ticket PAY-8421 updated. Subtask PAY-8421-SPLIT created. Reminder set for 24-hr follow-up.
Izzy Cole: Processing first payment now. If first charge succeeds, I'll apply to INV-5312 and flag second due.
Ravi Singh: First payment cleared. P1=7000 posted. Customer confirmed second card charged and pending.
Victor Huang: Great. Once P2 posts, finance please reconcile and mark invoice paid. Also update revenue recognition notes to reflect split cash receipt.
Nora Li: Will reconcile after P2 funds land. Ravi, please upload payment confirmation and signed plan to PAY-8421. Finance will mark invoice settled once P2 clears. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
